reviewBoundary: Newly authored provisional primary-school text practices. Exact answer evidence and every distractor were checked by the author only; this is not independent teacher review, learner calibration, an official examination or publication approval.

materials.title: Music Room Cushions 012
materials.text: In the music room, sit on a cushion to listen. Leave the drums on their stands. The teacher plays first. Clap after the short tune ends. The green drum has a loose skin; do not use it. Put cushions in the basket when the lesson is over.

questions.prompt: A friend takes a drum off its stand before listening. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: C鼓留支架；A篮子收坐垫非鼓；B边走边敲非听前安排。

questions.prompt: A friend wants to play before the teacher. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: A教师先演；B盖过教师、C全离开均不合顺序。

questions.prompt: A friend starts clapping in the middle of the tune. You say, "____"
options: Throw the cushion on the drum.
questions.explanation: B短曲结束再鼓掌；A全程拍违时机；C扔垫不是提醒方式。

questions.prompt: A friend chooses the green drum. You say, "____"
options: Do not use that drum; its skin is loose.
questions.explanation: C绿鼓鼓皮松禁用；A说可用相反；B带回家无许可。

questions.prompt: The lesson ends. A friend holds a cushion. You say, "____"
options: Put it outside in the mud.
questions.explanation: A课后垫入篮；B鼓上、C泥地均非收纳处。

materials.title: Paper Town Roads 012
materials.text: We build a paper town. Blue paper is for the river. Grey paper is for roads. Leave a gap for the bridge over the river. Use glue, not tape, for the small houses. Keep the school door clear. Put the name card beside each building, not on its roof.

questions.prompt: A friend uses blue paper for a road. You say, "____"
options: Use blue for all the roads.
Use grey paper for the road.
Use the river as a name card.
questions.explanation: B灰纸做路；A蓝纸供河非路；C河不作名牌。

questions.prompt: A friend covers the space for the bridge. You say, "____"
options: Leave that gap for the bridge.
questions.explanation: C桥需留口；A盖房占口、B全封违规划。

questions.prompt: A friend reaches for tape to stick a small house. You say, "____"
options: Use water to wash it away.
Do not put any house in the town.
questions.explanation: A小房子用胶不胶带；B冲掉、C不放房均非制作目标。

questions.prompt: A friend puts a shop in front of the school door. You say, "____"
options: Block the door with another shop.
questions.explanation: B校门畅通；A加堵相反；C拆屋顶非解决门前占用。

questions.prompt: A friend puts a building’s name card on its roof. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: C名牌在旁非屋顶；A河里、B底下均非可见指定位置。

materials.title: Pretend Vet Queue 012
materials.text: At our pretend animal clinic, each child gets a number card. The toy pets wait on the long bench. Only one child goes to the desk at a time. The child with card one goes first. Put toy dogs on the floor mat for a check. Small toy birds go on the table.

questions.prompt: Two children go to the desk together. You say, "____"
options: One child at a time, please.
questions.explanation: A一次一人；B所有人齐上违规则；C宠物长凳等候非户外。

questions.prompt: A friend holds card two and wants to go first. You say, "____"
options: You are first with card two.
The child with card one goes first.
questions.explanation: C一号先；A藏牌破坏顺序；B二号先与规则相反。

questions.prompt: A friend puts a waiting toy pet at the busy desk. You say, "____"
options: Let it wait on the long bench.
questions.explanation: B候诊玩具在长凳；A头上、C搬桌非候诊安排。

questions.prompt: A friend brings a toy dog for its check. You say, "____"
options: Put it on the floor mat.
Put it on the small bird table.
Hang it from the number card.
questions.explanation: A狗检查用地垫；B鸟用桌不同；C号码牌不能作检查悬挂处。

questions.prompt: A friend puts a small toy bird on the dog’s mat. You say, "____"
options: Put it under the bench to hide.
Put the bird on the table.
questions.explanation: C小鸟检查用桌；A狗垫、B藏凳下均不合分流。

materials.title: Wind Chime String 012
materials.text: Dad hangs a wind chime outside our window. It has three little bells. In the morning, I hear no sound. There is wind, but one long string is caught on the window handle. Dad frees the string. The bells move and ring again. At night, we bring the chime inside because my baby sister is sleeping. We hang it outside again after breakfast.

questions.prompt: The wind chime has four bells.
questions.explanation: B正确：three little bells；A把三改四。

questions.prompt: The morning is completely without wind.
questions.explanation: B正确：There is wind，绳被卡住才没响；A错将无声当无风。

questions.prompt: A string is caught on the window handle.
questions.explanation: A正确：string caught handle；B否认具体原因。

questions.prompt: The bells ring after Dad frees the string.
questions.explanation: A正确：解绳后move and ring again；B否认因果结果。

questions.prompt: The family brings the chime inside at night for the sleeping baby.
questions.explanation: A正确：because baby sister sleeping；B否认夜间处理原因。

materials.title: Borrowed Ball Dialogue 012
materials.text:
Order the dialogue. The fixed first line is: 1. Can I borrow your ball, please?
A. Yes, that is fine. Here you are.
B. Before lunch, please.
C. Thank you. When must I bring it back?
D. Yes, you can. Will you play in the garden?
E. No, I will play in the hall because it is raining.
Choose each line’s position from 2 to 6.

questions.prompt: What position does line A take?
questions.explanation: C第4步在获知室内玩后确认可以并递球；A第2步应先问花园；B第3步答室内；D第5步问归还；E第6步答饭前。

questions.prompt: What position does line B take?
questions.explanation: E第6步答归还时限；A第2步问场地；B第3步答场地；C第4步递球；D第5步才问时限。

questions.prompt: What position does line C take?
questions.explanation: D第5步接Here you are致谢再问还球；A第2步尚未讨论场地；B第3步答场地；C第4步递球；E第6步答时间。

questions.prompt: What position does line D take?
questions.explanation: A第2步先允许并问花园；B第3步应回答No室内；C第4步回应场地可行并递球；D第5步问还期；E第6步答饭前。

questions.prompt: What position does line E take?
questions.explanation: B第3步回答Will you play in garden；A第2步应先提出该问；C第4步确认递球；D第5步问还；E第6步答时间。

materials.title: Class Plant Sunshades 012
materials.text: The afternoon sun makes our classroom window very hot. We move the small plants away from the glass. One plant is too tall to move easily. The caretaker makes a paper shade for that pot. It stands between the plant and the glass but does not touch the leaves. Every morning, we take the shade away so the plant gets soft morning light. We put it back after lunch. A note on the pot explains the plan, so another class will not leave the shade there all day.

questions.prompt: Why are the small plants moved?
options: The afternoon window is very hot.
questions.explanation: C午后玻璃边过热；A没有入柜要求；B植物非没叶。

questions.prompt: Why does one plant get a shade instead of being moved?
options: It is too tall to move easily.
questions.explanation: C太高难搬；A纸制的是遮板非植物；B无异地归属。

questions.prompt: Where does the shade stand?
options: Between the plant and the glass.
questions.explanation: A植株和玻璃之间；B不触叶；C非土中位置。

questions.prompt: When is the shade taken away?
questions.explanation: B早晨拿掉受柔光；A午后放回；C午夜未安排。

questions.prompt: Why is there a note on the pot?
options: To explain the shade plan to another class.
To ask people to pick the leaves.
questions.explanation: A防另班全天留遮板；B售卖、C摘叶无据。

materials.title: Rain Gauge Emptying 012
materials.text: Our class measures rain with a clear tube in the garden. We read the water level at nine each morning. After writing the number, we empty the tube for the next day. On Tuesday, Leo forgets to empty it. Wednesday’s number includes water from two days. The teacher asks us to mark this beside the record, not pretend it is one day’s rain. We keep the number and explain the mistake. Leo puts a reminder card near the classroom door for future mornings.

questions.prompt: The class reads the tube at nine each morning.
questions.explanation: A正确：nine each morning；B否认固定测读时间。

questions.prompt: The tube is normally emptied before the number is read.
questions.explanation: B正确：先读写数后倒空；A颠倒顺序会丢失数据。

questions.prompt: Wednesday’s reading includes two days of water.
questions.explanation: A正确：周二忘倒空，周三含两日；B否认累积问题。

questions.prompt: The teacher asks the class to hide the mistake.
questions.explanation: B正确：记录旁标注并解释；A把透明说明改隐瞒。

questions.prompt: Leo adds a reminder for future readings.
questions.explanation: A正确：门旁放提醒卡；B否认改进动作。

units.title: 博物馆票上的入场时段

materials.title: Museum Ticket Split 012
materials.text: Our class buys museum tickets online. Half the tickets say 10:00 and the others say 10:30. We wanted one group, but there were not enough places at ten. The teacher divides us into two teams. The first team visits the display while the second draws in the covered courtyard with another teacher. At half past ten, the second team enters. We all meet beside the café at eleven thirty. We do not have to buy anything at the café.

questions.prompt: All tickets have the same entry time.
questions.explanation: B正确：一半10:00另一半10:30；A把分时票说成全同。

questions.prompt: The class wanted to enter as one group.
questions.explanation: A正确：wanted one group但十点余位不足；B否认初始愿望。

questions.prompt: The second team waits alone without a teacher.
questions.explanation: B正确：有another teacher在有顶庭院画画；A忽略陪同。

questions.prompt: The second team enters at 10:30.
questions.explanation: A正确：half past ten进入；B与时段安排相反。

questions.prompt: Everyone must buy a drink at the meeting place.
questions.explanation: B正确：不用在咖啡馆买东西；A擅加消费要求。

materials.title: School Garden Shift Card 012
materials.text:
Garden helpers: holiday rota
Monday: water pots near the greenhouse, 9:00–9:30, leader Mina.
Wednesday: check the vegetable beds, 8:30–9:15, leader Chen.
Friday: sweep paths and collect fallen pots, 9:00–10:00, leader Alex.
Please come only on the day you booked. If heavy rain makes watering unnecessary, Monday’s leader will send a message by eight. Wednesday’s check still takes place in light rain; wear suitable shoes. Friday helpers must not lift heavy broken pots themselves. A caretaker will handle those. Report a missed shift to the school office so another helper can be contacted. Do not swap shifts without telling the leader.

questions.prompt: Which job is on Wednesday?
questions.explanation: C周三菜床检查；A周五、B周一；D无售种任务。

questions.prompt: How long is Friday’s shift?
questions.explanation: D9至10一小时；A周一半小时；B周三45分钟；C两小时不符。

questions.prompt: Who tells Monday helpers if watering is unnecessary?
questions.explanation: A周一负责人Mina八点前消息；B为周五负责人；C咖啡员工、D每生单独通知均无据。

questions.prompt: What should Friday helpers do with a heavy broken pot?
options: Leave it for the caretaker to handle.
Hide it in a vegetable bed.
questions.explanation: B重破盆管理员处理；A不得自己抬；C单车运、D藏菜床非要求。

questions.prompt: What is required when changing a shift?
options: Change the rota without a message.
questions.explanation: A不能未告知就换班；B和D不通知违规则；C无全周取消要求。

units.title: 茶叶展台上的来源标签

materials.title: Tea Leaf Display 012
materials.text: For culture week, our class displayed three kinds of tea leaves. One family brought dried leaves from their own garden. A shop donated two sealed packets. We first wrote "All grown locally" because all the leaves had reached us from people in town. Then a parent pointed out that a local shop could sell tea grown far away. We checked the packets and changed the labels. The garden leaves were marked with the family’s permission. The shop packets listed their printed growing regions. Where we could not confirm a detail, we wrote "Not confirmed" instead of making a guess. Visitors could smell the dry leaves, but the display did not offer drinks.

questions.prompt: Every tea leaf was proved to have been grown in the town.
questions.explanation: B正确：原先把本地获得当本地种植，后查有外地区信息；A重复已纠正说法。

questions.prompt: A shop donated two sealed packets.
questions.explanation: A正确：two sealed packets；B否认来源数量。

questions.prompt: The class changed its labels after checking the packets.
questions.explanation: A正确：checked packets and changed labels；B否认纠正过程。

questions.prompt: The class guessed any detail it could not confirm.
questions.explanation: B正确：写Not confirmed而非猜；A与不确定性说明相反。

questions.prompt: Visitors could smell leaves but were not served tea.
questions.explanation: A正确：smell dry leaves，no drinks；B将闻与饮混淆。

units.title: 体育动作录像的慢放误解

materials.title: Sports Video Slow Motion 012
materials.text:
The PE club filmed a relay exchange to help pupils improve. In normal speed, the pass looked quick. When the clip was slowed down, a pupil said the receiver had waited far too long. The coach reminded the group that slow motion stretches every part of the action. The length on the screen was not the same as the real waiting time.
They watched the clip with a timer showing the original seconds. It revealed a short pause, but not the long delay some pupils had imagined. They also checked a view from the side because one runner’s arm blocked the front camera. The club used both views to choose one improvement: the receiver would show an open hand earlier. They did not post the clip publicly. It was kept in the school account for the team’s next practice, with the pupils’ agreement.

questions.prompt: What caused the first misunderstanding?
options: Treating slow-motion screen time as real waiting time.
questions.explanation: C慢放拉长时长被误当真等待；A跑者未缺；B距离未变；D无倒走时钟。

questions.prompt: What helped the group judge the actual pause?
options: A poster with no time marks.
A public vote about the video.
questions.explanation: B原始秒数计时；A无时间海报、C单帧、D公众投票均非方法。

questions.prompt: Why did they use the side view?
options: An arm blocked the front view.
The side view made the race longer.
The front camera had no colour.
They wanted to hide the receiver.
questions.explanation: A手臂挡正面；B视角不改赛程；C颜色、D隐藏目的无据。

questions.prompt: What improvement did the team choose?
options: Show the receiver’s open hand earlier.
questions.explanation: D更早伸开放手；A停练、B拉长表象、C全换项目非结果。

questions.prompt: How was the clip kept?
options: In a school account for agreed team practice.
In an unknown visitor’s phone only.
questions.explanation: B获同意校账号供下次练；A和C公开与not post相反；D访客私机无据。

units.title: 学校汤品配方变更的通知

materials.title: School Meal Recipe Change 012
materials.text:
The kitchen changed its vegetable soup recipe because one ingredient was unavailable. The replacement had a similar colour, so the soup looked almost the same. A kitchen assistant suggested leaving the menu unchanged to avoid confusing pupils. The manager disagreed. Appearance did not tell diners what was inside.
The team updated the ingredient list and told teachers before lunch. Pupils with recorded food restrictions received their usual individually checked meal. The kitchen did not assume that a familiar-looking soup was suitable for them. A notice also said that the replacement was for this week only. When the original ingredient returned, staff would check and update the list again. In the review, the manager praised the early suggestion because discussing it had made the communication gap visible before serving began.

questions.prompt: The replacement ingredient made the soup look very different.
questions.explanation: B正确：颜色近似，looked almost same；A把外观近似改不同。

questions.prompt: The manager accepted the suggestion to leave the ingredient list unchanged.
questions.explanation: B正确：manager disagreed并更新；A把被拒建议当采纳。

questions.prompt: Teachers were informed before lunch.
questions.explanation: A正确：told teachers before lunch；B否认通知时机。

questions.prompt: The kitchen relied only on the soup’s familiar appearance for pupils with restrictions.
questions.explanation: B正确：仍用单独核查餐，不靠外观推定；A与明确程序相反。

questions.prompt: The team planned to check the list again when the original ingredient returned.
questions.explanation: A正确：恢复原料时再核更新；B否认后续安排。
